newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Guinness new shares in Nigerian unit listed.
newsitem.headline: Guinness new shares in Nigerian unit listed.

text.p: The Nigerian stock exchange on Thursday listed 139 million shares of Guinness Nigeria recently acquired by Guinness Plc, effectively giving the worldwide group control in the local subsidiary.
There was no cash involvement as the foreign company converted a loan stock worth 426.8 million naira to ordinary shares, dealers said.
"It increases the foreign investor's stake in Guinness Nigeria from 40 percent to 52 percent and gives Guinness Worldwide effective management of the company," one said.
As a result, Guinness Nigeria's market capitalisation rose to about 5.5 billion naira, consolidating its second position in the brewing sector behind Nigerian Breweries.
Dealers said the development would have no impact on trading in the near term as they did not expect the shares to be traded on the floor of the exchange.
Guinness Nigeria's shares were unchanged in trading at 8.16 naira.
